title: Common — identical in every environment
summary: The shared trunk. Code here may never name or branch on an environment, and any configuration value that is the same everywhere belongs here and nowhere else.
invariants: No file under an enforcedTree may branch on an environment identity (a site name, a host name, an organisation). Checked by test/env-profiles.test.mjs. enforcedTrees is product code only: test/ is a shared tree but its fixtures may legitimately contain a real account or domain name as DATA.
Every environment difference reaches the shared trees as a PW_* variable, never as a conditional.
A value identical in every environment lives in this profile only; an environment profile may not repeat it.
A value that differs lives in each environment profile that sets it, and may not appear in this profile.
notes: PW_AUTH_ENFORCE lives here because every environment requires it. The no-overlap gate (test/env-profiles.test.mjs) moved it: it was declared identically in both environment profiles.

PW_SESSION_BOARD_DIR is common: the session board is host-local coordination, identical in every environment. A deployment that relocates it declares it in its own profile and removes it from here, which the no-overlap gate will require.
